title: Phase 26 · Admission Audit Report

candidates.name: KIOS 2022 Archive

candidates.name: Synthetic AirSim Frames
candidates.reason: Synthetic rendered imagery; not suitable as independent real-image evaluation

candidates.name: Gazebo ArUco Frames

summary: All six candidate sources failed admission. KIOS archives share 100% overlap with existing evaluation data. IMAV 2025 is blocked at the provenance gate. Synthetic sources are categorically excluded. The admission criteria are preserved without weakening.
